# Selftest deny-list — IMP-027 SCOPE-2b
#
# framework-validate.sh discovers every bubbles/scripts/*-selftest.sh and runs
# any that its enumerated checks did not already cover. That means a NEW
# selftest is executed the moment it is committed, with no wiring step — which
# is the point: COV-2 was a class of silently-unwired selftests, not a set of
# individual oversights.
#
# A selftest listed here is deliberately NOT run by the discovery sweep. Each
# entry MUST carry a reason on the line above it. `selftest-coverage-lint.sh`
# fails when an entry has no reason, and when a denied selftest no longer
# exists (so this file cannot rot).
#
# Format: one basename per line. Blank lines and `#` comments ignored.
# Every entry MUST be preceded by a comment line giving the reason.

# Already executed by framework-validate through
# `bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/cli.sh" repository-binding-selftest --suite=all`. That
# wrapper sets BUBBLES_REPOSITORY_BINDING_CLI_BOUNDARY=1, which the suite itself
# asserts (case RB-CLI-BOUNDARY-EXECUTED). The sweep dedupes against enumerated
# checks by FILE name, and the cli spelling of that check carries no `.sh`, so
# discovery cannot see it as already-wired. A direct second run therefore fails
# that assertion BY CONSTRUCTION — the suite is contracted to run only through
# the CLI boundary.
repository-binding-selftest.sh

# Executed as a child suite by repository-binding-selftest.sh, which holds it in
# CONFORMANCE_SELFTEST and runs it as the `conformance` suite. That reference
# lives in a sibling script rather than in framework-validate.sh, so the sweep
# cannot observe it. Discovery would re-run the entire conformance suite for
# zero additional coverage.
repository-binding-conformance-guard-selftest.sh
